cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Earth.

phrases.text: Earth.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: For hundreds of thousands of years, it has been home to the human species.

phrases.text: For hundreds of thousands of years,
it has been home to the human species.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: By the twenty-first century, humanity had transformed much of its planet.

phrases.text: By the twenty-first century,
humanity had transformed much of its planet.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Its civilizations had built vast cities, developed powerful technologies, and begun exploring the space beyond their atmosphere.

phrases.text: Its civilizations had built vast cities,
developed powerful technologies,
and begun exploring the space beyond their atmosphere.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Humanity had long wondered whether other civilizations existed among the stars.

phrases.text: Humanity had long wondered
whether other civilizations existed among the stars.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Few imagined that one had already taken an interest in Earth.

phrases.text: Few imagined that one had already taken an interest in Earth.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Far beyond the Solar System lay the Hegemony, an immense interstellar civilization whose influence extended across numerous star systems.

phrases.text: Far beyond the Solar System lay the Hegemony,
an immense interstellar civilization
whose influence extended across numerous star systems.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Its expansion was driven by political ambition, economic interests, and the continuous demand for new resources and productive territories.

phrases.text: Its expansion was driven by political ambition,
economic interests, and the continuous demand
for new resources and productive territories.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Earth had attracted its attention.

phrases.text: Earth had attracted its attention.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Earth had already been surveyed, and the Hegemony had determined that the planet was a suitable target for expansion.

phrases.text: Earth had already been surveyed,
and the Hegemony had determined that the planet
was a suitable target for expansion.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Its authorities approved the acquisition and issued a charter to the Sol Development Company.

phrases.text: Its authorities approved the acquisition
and issued a charter to the Sol Development Company.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: The Company was given six years to bring Earth under Hegemony control and integrate its economy into the wider interstellar system.

phrases.text: The Company was given six years
to bring Earth under Hegemony control
and integrate its economy into the wider interstellar system.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: An expedition was assembled around a single interstellar carrier, Caravan,

phrases.text: An expedition was assembled around
a single interstellar carrier, Caravan,

cues.visual: Atlas mark resolves into the carrier

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: carrying advanced machinery, industrial equipment, and the essential components of a future invasion force.

phrases.text: carrying advanced machinery, industrial equipment,
and the essential components of a future invasion force.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Its destination was the Solar System.

phrases.text: Its destination was the Solar System.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Its objective was Earth.

phrases.text: Its objective was Earth.

cues.visual: Hold on Caravan before resource branch

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Caravan sent mining equipment to the asteroid belt. A small reserve followed, in case the main workshops were lost.

phrases.text: Caravan sent mining equipment to the asteroid belt.
A small reserve followed,
in case the main workshops were lost.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: The workshop packages headed inward. They arrived between Earth and the Moon, in a region called cislunar space.

phrases.text: The workshop packages headed inward.
They arrived between Earth and the Moon,
in a region called cislunar space.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: The workshops received shipments of rock from the belt. Some pieces held ice. Others held metal.

phrases.text: The workshops received shipments of rock from the belt.
Some pieces held ice.
Others held metal.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: At Foundry Alpha, ice became water. Some of that water was turned into propellant for the ships carrying the next loads.

phrases.text: At Foundry Alpha, ice became water.
Some of that water was turned into propellant
for the ships carrying the next loads.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Foundry Beta refined metal from the rock and shaped it into beams. Tugs carried the pieces to the assembly yard.

phrases.text: Foundry Beta refined metal from the rock
and shaped it into beams.
Tugs carried the pieces to the assembly yard.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Foundry Gamma joined the beams into frames. Those frames held precision instruments that Caravan had brought from home.

phrases.text: Foundry Gamma joined the beams into frames.
Those frames held precision instruments
that Caravan had brought from home.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Depots held cargo until the next transfer. The workshops could keep different schedules.

phrases.text: Depots held cargo until the next transfer.
The workshops could keep different schedules.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: A fourth branch was called Foundry Delta. Its precise role remains uncertain.

phrases.text: A fourth branch was called Foundry Delta.
Its precise role remains uncertain.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: By now the Company could supply equipment in Earth orbit. From below, an object arriving there gave little indication of the industry behind it.

phrases.text: By now the Company could supply equipment in Earth orbit.
From below, an object arriving there
gave little indication of the industry behind it.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Some of these objects entered human tracking records. A track could establish where something had been, and where to look for it again.

phrases.text: Some of these objects entered human tracking records.
A track could establish where something had been,
and where to look for it again.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: What it carried, who had built it, and why it was there were harder questions.

phrases.text: What it carried, who had built it,
and why it was there were harder questions.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: With ninety days left before contact, the workshops began handing over finished equipment.

phrases.text: With ninety days left before contact,
the workshops began handing over finished equipment.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Near Earth, cargo from the Moon’s neighbourhood began to appear in separate groups in orbit.

phrases.text: Near Earth, cargo from the Moon’s neighbourhood
began to appear in separate groups in orbit.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Among it were Quivers: disposable dispensers carrying the glide munitions of the opening Wave.

phrases.text: Among it were Quivers: disposable dispensers
carrying the glide munitions of the opening Wave.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: A tug could spend weeks moving freight. There was time because the public deadline was still ahead.

phrases.text: A tug could spend weeks moving freight.
There was time because the public deadline was still ahead.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Wardens coordinated traffic in orbit. Far below them, Lanterns sensed and relayed from the stratosphere.

phrases.text: Wardens coordinated traffic in orbit.
Far below them, Lanterns sensed and relayed
from the stratosphere.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Asteroids supplied metal. Compact fusion systems and high-grade seekers came from home.

phrases.text: Asteroids supplied metal.
Compact fusion systems and high-grade seekers
came from home.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: At Gamma, another assembly took shape around precision components drawn from a finite stock.

phrases.text: At Gamma, another assembly took shape
around precision components drawn from a finite stock.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: At an observatory, two exposures might show a point of light changing position. The measurement could be sound while its meaning remained unclear.

phrases.text: At an observatory, two exposures might show
a point of light changing position.
The measurement could be sound
while its meaning remained unclear.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: The scattered observations never became a warning governments could act on. The people comparing them had only pieces of the picture.

phrases.text: The scattered observations never became a warning
governments could act on.
The people comparing them had only pieces of the picture.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Domesday sensors covered selected ground corridors. Much of the terrain remained unseen.

phrases.text: Domesday sensors covered selected ground corridors.
Much of the terrain remained unseen.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: In the final weeks, the workshops kept working as more of their output took its place above Earth.

phrases.text: In the final weeks, the workshops kept working
as more of their output took its place above Earth.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: One dispenser had already been set aside for a demonstration. Its public announcement would come later.

phrases.text: One dispenser had already been set aside for a demonstration.
Its public announcement would come later.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: An inert Scythe would give observers a prediction to check. The event was still ahead.

phrases.text: An inert Scythe would give observers a prediction to check.
The event was still ahead.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: Nineteen months had passed since the Caravan arrived. On Earth, the first public word was still to come.

phrases.text: Nineteen months had passed since the Caravan arrived.
On Earth, the first public word was still to come.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.transcript: The Company opened a public channel.

phrases.text: The Company opened a public channel.

cues.speaker: Company transmission
cues.transcript: This transmission is of nonhuman origin.

phrases.text: This transmission is of nonhuman origin.

cues.speaker: Company transmission
cues.transcript: Leave military equipment and military structures.

phrases.text: Leave military equipment and military structures.
